about_the_game:
The Eternal Laughter Circus has plunged into chaos! Enraged clowns, demanding long-overdue wages, have gone to war against their former owner. You have to stand up for the last bastion of fun - the circus tent! Take everything you can get your hands on - from throwing pies and jester's hammers to flamethrowers and chainsaws - and fight back against the raging army of redheads. Your task: hold the line at any cost and prevent the clowns from destroying the tent to the ground!

Clown Madness is a dynamic 2D pixel art platformer with elements of a shooter and base defense. Squeeze everything out of the arsenal of circus madness, fighting off waves of increasingly ferocious and unusual clowns. Every second counts - protect the symbol of your circus!

Game features:

- Beautiful pixel art

- Musical style

- High Difficulty

- Responsive Controls
